comparison.objective: Trace a leaking coolant branch and close only its associated valve.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual topology tracing followed by quarter-turn lever manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: Correct valve shut, other valves remain open, hands clear for 1 s; wrong-valve actuation is fatal.
comparison.reason: Tests perceptual line tracing and selective valve actuation, not bimanual impact tooling or fragment recovery.
